prompt: Production 2D hand-painted fantasy RPG animation sprite atlas. SQUARE RGB OPAQUE PURE MAGENTA #FF00FF background, no alpha. EXACT 6 columns by 6 rows, thirty-six SEPARATE full-body miniature sprites. Same person, costume, weapon, scale and right-facing three-quarter view every frame. Each sprite no more than 65% cell width, generous 35px magenta gutters, NO touching neighbouring poses. No text, no grid lines, no scenery or floor. Adult anatomy, fine painterly details at 150px character height, NOT chibi, NOT 3D. SUBJECT: slender adult European-looking woman with dark chestnut braided bun, ivory and navy scholar dress with fitted sleeves, gold celestial embroidery, burgundy waist ribbon and black boots. Held equipment MUST be: two small metal throwing daggers, one drawn in right hand and one in belt. SIX ROWS, each six frames: ROW1 idle breathing loop; ROW2 attack: ready, anticipation, windup, strong contact/release, follow-through, recovery. Raise throwing arm behind shoulder, twist torso then whip arm forward releasing one tiny dagger with a short motion trace, draw replacement. ROW3 hit recoil and recovery; ROW4 defensive guard and recovery using this actual equipment, no extra sword; ROW5 evasive crouch step then recovery; ROW6 collapse/defeat ending lying motionless. SAME costume throughout: slender adult European-looking woman with dark chestnut braided bun, ivory and navy scholar dress with fitted sleeves, gold celestial embroidery, burgundy waist ribbon and black boots. Weapon must remain recognizable, same proportions, grip anatomically correct. No swords except those explicitly requested. No touching neighbours. Solid opaque magenta everywhere between characters, no transparency.
